valuation.method: Forward Core EPS x justified P/E (FY2027 Core EPS viewed at the 12-month target date), converted from CAD reporting currency at the 2026-11-13 USD/CAD close of 1.4271 (1 CAD = 0.7007 USD), cross-checked against 3Q26 Adjusted BVPS of C$41.78 (US$29.28) and 17.8% Core ROE.

bear.driver: ALDA return headwinds, slower Asia growth, or persistent Global WAM net outflows
bear.assumption: FY2027 Core EPS US$3.22 (C$4.60) at 11.5x P/E

base.driver: Steady Asia & North America insurance growth, Core ROE ~18%, disciplined capital return
base.assumption: FY2027 Core EPS US$3.54 (C$5.05) at 13.0x P/E

bull.driver: Core ROE exceeds 18%+ target, Global WAM returns to net inflows, multiple expansion
bull.assumption: FY2027 Core EPS US$3.82 (C$5.45) at 14.5x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 Core EPS of US$3.54 (C$5.05), the $44.06 close implies 12.4x forward Core P/E; RBC's $46.95 USD (C$67.00) target implies 13.3x base Core EPS or US$3.61 EPS at 13.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.54 (8.0 pp at the $44.06 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Core ROE (17.8% in 3Q26 vs. 18%+ 2027 target) and Global WAM net flows (-$3.6B in 3Q26 vs. -$6.2B in 3Q25)

analyst_notes: RBC Capital Markets' Darko Mihelic raised his target from C$55 ($38.54 USD) to C$67 ($46.95 USD) with an Outperform rating on 2026-08-07, predating the 2026-11-04 3Q26 earnings release (+6.6% implied upside vs. +4.4% base case). Other covering Canadian lifeco analysts (including BMO's Tom MacKinnon at C$70 / $49.05 USD and Desjardins' Doug Young at C$63 / $44.15 USD) maintain targets in the C$61–C$70 range, though exact 2026 publication dates for those notes were not verified in public sources.
